schema.description: An administrator asks a trust registry to rotate the keys of the registry's own agent-managed did:webvh in place, preserving the DID while refreshing its key material. Field names are snake_case, frozen from the pre-existing deployed wire form this specification documents (matching the registry/* family convention).

label.description: Operator-facing audit label for the rotation.

pre_rotation_count.description: Override the number of pre-rotation key commitments published for the new key set. Absent: the managing agent's default.
